intent: Commit the analyzer exclude block that `flutter pub get` writes into focus_owner/analysis_options.yaml, so it stops reappearing as an uncommitted change in every session.
scope: Non-goal: no change to lib/ or test/ code, no lint rule added or removed
changes: Add the analyzer.exclude block (build/, android/, ios/, web/, windows/, macos/, linux/) that the Flutter toolchain generates during `flutter pub get`.

verification.command: flutter pub get (in a detached worktree at HEAD)
verification.evidence: Emitted 'Upgrading analysis_options.yaml to exclude build and platform directories' and produced a diff byte-identical to the working-tree change, confirming the edit is tool-generated and idempotent rather than hand-authored.

verification.command: dart analyze (detached worktree at HEAD, packages resolved, exclude reverted)
verification.evidence: No issues found! -- baseline is also clean, so the exclude is a forward-looking guard against platform-dir noise, not a fix for existing warnings. An earlier run reporting 1136 issues was invalid: that worktree had no .dart_tool/package_config.json, so package:flutter did not resolve.

risks: The exclude hides analyzer findings in android/ios/web/windows/macos/linux if hand-written Dart is ever added there; focus_owner keeps its Dart in lib/ and test/, so nothing is masked today.
Low blast radius: analyzer configuration only, no runtime code path touched.
rollback: git revert the commit, or delete the analyzer: block from focus_owner/analysis_options.yaml.
Re-run `dart analyze` in focus_owner and confirm 'No issues found!'; note that the next `flutter pub get` will rewrite the block.
